name: add_ruby_order_coupon_percentage_and_fixed
description: Add percentage AND fixed-amount coupon support to Order#total_with_coupon, with a minimum-order-value gate on fixed coupons only; broken forgets to clamp the fixed discount at 0, letting a large fixed coupon push the total negative
prompts: Order#total in order.rb just returns the subtotal with no coupon support at all. Add a total_with_coupon(coupon) method where coupon is a Hash with a :type key. For type: :percentage, apply coupon[:value] as a percent-off discount with NO minimum order requirement. For type: :fixed, subtract coupon[:value] dollars off the subtotal, but ONLY if the subtotal is at or above coupon[:min_order] (if min_order is present and the subtotal is below it, the fixed coupon has no effect at all) - and the resulting total must never go below 0, no matter how large the fixed discount is relative to the subtotal. Keep the existing total method unchanged.

test_setup_files.order_hidden_test.rb:
require "minitest/autorun"
require_relative "order"

class OrderCouponTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_percentage_coupon_no_minimum
    order = Order.new(200.0)
    assert_in_delta 180.0, order.total_with_coupon(type: :percentage, value: 10)
  end

  def test_fixed_coupon_applies_when_at_or_above_minimum
    order = Order.new(100.0)
    coupon = { type: :fixed, value: 20, min_order: 50 }
    assert_in_delta 80.0, order.total_with_coupon(coupon)
  end

  def test_fixed_coupon_does_not_apply_below_minimum
    order = Order.new(40.0)
    coupon = { type: :fixed, value: 20, min_order: 50 }
    assert_in_delta 40.0, order.total_with_coupon(coupon)
  end

  def test_fixed_coupon_never_goes_negative
    order = Order.new(15.0)
    coupon = { type: :fixed, value: 20, min_order: 10 }
    assert_in_delta 0.0, order.total_with_coupon(coupon)
  end

  def test_percentage_coupon_ignores_min_order_key_if_present
    order = Order.new(10.0)
    coupon = { type: :percentage, value: 50, min_order: 1000 }
    assert_in_delta 5.0, order.total_with_coupon(coupon)
  end
end

reference_solution.order.rb:
class Order
  def initialize(subtotal)
    @subtotal = subtotal
  end

  def total
    @subtotal
  end

  # coupon is a Hash:
  #   { type: :percentage, value: 10 }                 -> 10% off, no minimum
  #   { type: :fixed, value: 20, min_order: 50 }        -> $20 off, only if
  #     @subtotal >= min_order (a fixed coupon has no effect below that);
  #     the discount can never take the total below 0.
  def total_with_coupon(coupon)
    case coupon[:type]
    when :percentage
      @subtotal * (1 - coupon[:value] / 100.0)
    when :fixed
      if coupon[:min_order] && @subtotal < coupon[:min_order]
        @subtotal
      else
        [@subtotal - coupon[:value], 0].max
      end
    else
      @subtotal
    end
  end
end
